title: Survey other AMD BIOS scrapers and compare access strategies
description:
Question: 

Context: 

Findings: 

Before publishing, do a literature/ecosystem search for other AMD BIOS firmware scrapers (e.g. coreboot blob downloaders, vendor-firmware aggregators, prior research projects). For each, capture: which vendors they cover, how they access the CDN (direct, Wayback CDX, Selenium/Playwright, signed download URLs, session cookies, etc.), what unwrapping they do, and whether they handle bot-detection.  Outcome: a short comparison table in README or a docs/ page. May also surface better techniques than our current Akamai-bypass User-Agent in gigabyte.py.
